title: ID0372450-DC/SI-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/06]-SIM/Router issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The charging station disconnects from SCB very frequently. The SIM card is indicated as not inserted when I connect to the router interface. During my last intervention, I spent a long time finding the position where it is detected. Unfortunately, when the station disconnects from SCB for too long, the connectors turn white, and the station becomes out of service for the customers. Could you schedule an intervention with the French teams to improve the SIM detection? (new SIM holder or new router)
Root cause:
Solution:
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status:
